titles.title: White Primrose

description: Two white primrose flowers with yellow centers fill the composition. One flower, seen from its side, occupies the lower half of the image, while the other, seen from above, stretches across the top half. The blooms cast blue shadows on a pale pink background.
title: White Primrose
